incident_type: Monsoon Inundation at VN Purav Marg Central Arterial
text: CRITICAL DISPATCH: Severe monsoon flash flooding and drainage backflow have submerged VN Purav Marg central arterial under 75cm of standing water. Exceeds standard ambulance 20cm clearance threshold. Central corridor impassable to wheeled emergency vehicles.
action_required: Enforce perimeter closure at Chembur Naka. Reroute emergency ambulances via Sindhi Society and Acres Club bypass corridor.

source: MMRDA Structural Sensor & PWD Satellite Recon
incident_type: Expansion Joint Shear Slip on Panjarpol Elevated Freeway Ramp
text: STRUCTURAL ALERT: Panjarpol Elevated Freeway Ramp southern expansion joint has sheared 14cm with severe transverse pier displacement. Complete bridge deck collapse hazard under dynamic vehicular loads.
action_required: Immediate total closure of Panjarpol elevated ramp. Prohibit emergency crossings. Reroute heavy convoys via ground-level arterials.

incident_type: Operational Facility Status at Inlaks Hospital
text: FACILITY ADVISORY: Inlaks General Hospital access corridor along Postal Colony is dry and fully traversable. Baseline emergency intake active with 24 general beds available.
action_required: Corridor open for standard emergency vehicle intake.

text: PATROL UPDATE: Suman-Shell connector inspected and cleared of debris. Roadway dry, power lines secure, full two-lane traversability restored.
action_required: Maintain open arterial flow for emergency services.

incident_type: Normal Traffic Flow on Pestom Sagar Link
text: TRAFFIC ADVISORY: Pestom Sagar North link surface is dry and open to local traffic. No water pooling detected.

incident_type: Clear Elevated Corridor Verified on Eastern Freeway
text: RECON CLEARANCE: Aerial thermal scanning confirms Eastern Freeway Panjarpol elevated span is dry, structural pillars intact, and completely clear of flood waters. Ideal high-speed emergency corridor.
action_required: Designate Eastern Freeway as primary heavy convoy artery.
